notice: Reference API Request contracts only. Credentials and live Vapi/Twilio delivery are deployment concerns; this file contains no secret values.

tools.name: ordernexa_status_lookup
tools.security_rule: This endpoint intentionally never returns customer identity, prices, delivery details, payment data, or write authority. Caller identity must be verified outside this endpoint before disclosing sensitive order information.

tools.name: ordernexa_change_request

body_schema.request_note: Short caller request; never include card/bank credentials.

tools.result_semantics: Creates a PENDING_VERIFICATION review request only. It never modifies Odoo or approves a business change.

credential_strategy: Use a reusable Vapi Custom Credential for X-OrderNexa-Voice-Secret. Never embed the secret in prompts, tool descriptions, exported JSON, screenshots or source control.
